questions.text: निम्न ग्राफ निरूपित करता है:
questions.text_english: The following graph represents:
questions.solution: The graph shows a strictly decreasing function defined for all real x with range (0, π). It passes through (0, π/2) — wait, the graph shows two marked points: (0, π) and (0, π/2). The function y = cot⁻¹x has domain ℝ, range (0, π), and is strictly decreasing. At x = 0, cot⁻¹(0) = π/2. As x → ∞, cot⁻¹x → 0⁺ and as x → -∞, cot⁻¹x → π⁻. The y-intercept is π/2, and the curve tends to π on the left and 0 on the right, which matches the graph. Hence the answer is (B) y = cot⁻¹x.
questions.solution_hindi: ग्राफ एक ऐसे फलन को दर्शाता है जो सभी वास्तविक x के लिए परिभाषित है तथा परास (0, π) है। y = cot⁻¹x का डोमेन ℝ, परास (0, π) है तथा x = 0 पर इसका मान π/2 है, जो ग्राफ से मेल खाता है।

questions.text: माना A = [aᵢⱼ] कोटि 2×2 का एक आव्यूह है, जिसके अवयव aᵢⱼ = (2i − j)²/3 द्वारा दिए गए हैं। तो A' है:
questions.text_english: Let A = [aᵢⱼ] be a 2×2 matrix whose elements are given by aᵢⱼ = (2i − j)²/3. Then A' is:
questions.solution: We compute each element using aᵢⱼ = (2i − j)²/3. a₁₁ = (2·1−1)²/3 = 1/3, a₁₂ = (2·1−2)²/3 = 0, a₂₁ = (2·2−1)²/3 = 9/3 = 3, a₂₂ = (2·2−2)²/3 = 4/3. So A = [[1/3, 0], [3, 4/3]]. The transpose A' is obtained by interchanging rows and columns: A' = [[1/3, 3], [0, 4/3]]. Wait — that matches option (A). Let me recheck option (D): [[4/3, 0], [3, 1/3]] — this would require a₁₁=4/3, a₁₂=0, a₂₁=3, a₂₂=1/3. Since A = [[1/3, 0], [3, 4/3]], A' = [[1/3, 3], [0, 4/3]], which is option (A). The correct answer is (A).

questions.text_english: If points (2, 3), (0, 4) and (p, 2) are collinear, then the value of p is:
questions.solution: For collinearity of three points, the area of the triangle formed by them must be zero. Using the determinant condition: (1/2)|x₁(y₂−y₃) + x₂(y₃−y₁) + x₃(y₁−y₂)| = 0. Substituting: 2(4−2) + 0(2−3) + p(3−4) = 0 ⟹ 2(2) + 0 + p(−1) = 0 ⟹ 4 − p = 0 ⟹ p = 4. The correct answer is (C) 4.

questions.text: e^(eˣ) का x के सापेक्ष अवकलज है:
questions.text_english: Differential of e^(eˣ) with respect to x is:
questions.solution: Let y = e^(eˣ). Using the chain rule, dy/dx = e^(eˣ) · d(eˣ)/dx = e^(eˣ) · eˣ = eˣ · e^(eˣ). This is the correct differentiation applying the chain rule twice. Option (C) eˣ · e^(eˣ) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: y = e^(eˣ) का x के सापेक्ष अवकलज श्रृंखला नियम से: dy/dx = e^(eˣ) · eˣ।

questions.text: sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) का मुख्य मान है:
questions.text_english: The principal value of sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) is:
questions.solution: sec⁻¹(√2) = π/4, since sec(π/4) = √2. cosec⁻¹(−√2) = −π/4, since cosec(−π/4) = −√2 and the principal value range of cosec⁻¹ is [−π/2, π/2] \ {0}. Therefore, sec⁻¹(√2) + 2·cosec⁻¹(−√2) = π/4 + 2·(−π/4) = π/4 − π/2 = −π/4. The correct answer is (B) −π/4.
questions.topic: Principal Values of Inverse Trigonometric Functions

questions.text: यदि एक कण द्वारा t सेकण्ड में तय की गई दूरी S = 72t + 3t² − t³ द्वारा प्रदत्त है, तो इस कण के विराम अवस्था में आने में लिया गया समय है:
questions.text_english: If the distance travelled by a particle in t seconds is given by S = 72t + 3t² − t³, then time taken by the particle to come to rest is:
questions.solution: The particle comes to rest when its velocity is zero. Velocity v = dS/dt = 72 + 6t − 3t². Setting v = 0: 3t² − 6t − 72 = 0 ⟹ t² − 2t − 24 = 0 ⟹ (t − 6)(t + 4) = 0 ⟹ t = 6 or t = −4. Since time cannot be negative, t = 6 seconds. The correct answer is (B) 6 seconds.
questions.solution_hindi: वेग v = dS/dt = 72 + 6t − 3t² = 0 ⟹ t² − 2t − 24 = 0 ⟹ t = 6 सेकण्ड।

questions.text: ∫ dx/√(25 − 16x²) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: ∫ dx/√(25 − 16x²) is equal to:
questions.solution: We write √(25 − 16x²) = √(25(1 − (4x/5)²)) = 5√(1 − (4x/5)²). So ∫ dx / (5√(1−(4x/5)²)). Let u = 4x/5, then du = 4/5 dx, so dx = 5/4 du. The integral becomes ∫ (5/4) du / (5√(1−u²)) = (1/4) ∫ du/√(1−u²) = (1/4) sin⁻¹(u) + C = (1/4) sin⁻¹(4x/5) + C. The correct answer is (C).

questions.text: यदि ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = tan⁻¹ e + k है, तो k का मान है:
questions.text_english: If ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = tan⁻¹ e + k, then the value of k is:
questions.solution: ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = ∫₀¹ eˣ dx/(e²ˣ + 1). Let t = eˣ, dt = eˣ dx. When x=0, t=1; when x=1, t=e. Integral = ∫₁ᵉ dt/(t²+1) = [tan⁻¹t]₁ᵉ = tan⁻¹e − tan⁻¹1 = tan⁻¹e − π/4. Given this equals tan⁻¹e + k, we get k = −π/4. The correct answer is (D).
questions.solution_hindi: t = eˣ प्रतिस्थापन से ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ+e⁻ˣ) = tan⁻¹e − π/4। अतः k = −π/4।

questions.text: यदि f(x) = { (sinx/x) + cosx, x ≠ 0 ; k, x = 0 } x = 0 पर संतत है, तो k का मान है:
questions.text_english: If f(x) = { (sinx/x) + cosx, x ≠ 0 ; k, x = 0 } is continuous at x = 0, then the value of k is:
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 0, we need lim(x→0) f(x) = f(0) = k. lim(x→0) [(sinx/x) + cosx] = lim(x→0)(sinx/x) + lim(x→0)(cosx) = 1 + 1 = 2. Therefore k = 2. The correct answer is (D) 2.
questions.solution_hindi: x = 0 पर संततता के लिए lim(x→0) f(x) = k। lim(x→0)(sinx/x + cosx) = 1 + 1 = 2। अतः k = 2।

questions.text: वक्र y = x तथा x-अक्ष द्वारा x = 0 तथा x = 2 के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है:
questions.text_english: The area of the region bounded by the curve y = x and x-axis, between x = 0 and x = 2 is:
questions.solution: Area = ∫₀² x dx = [x²/2]₀² = 4/2 − 0 = 2 square units. The curve y = x is a straight line, and the area between x = 0 and x = 2 forms a right triangle with base 2 and height 2, giving area = (1/2)(2)(2) = 2 sq. units. The correct answer is (A) 2 sq. units.
questions.solution_hindi: क्षेत्रफल = ∫₀² x dx = [x²/2]₀² = 2 वर्ग इकाई।

questions.text: महत्तम पूर्णांक फलन f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3, कितने बिन्दुओं पर अवकलनीय नहीं है?
questions.text_english: The greatest integer function, f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3 is not differentiable at how many points?
questions.solution: The greatest integer function [x] is not differentiable at integer points, because at each integer the left-hand derivative and right-hand derivative are not equal (the function has a jump discontinuity). In the open interval (0, 3), the integers are x = 1 and x = 2. Therefore, f(x) = [x] is not differentiable at exactly two points. The correct answer is (B) At only two points.
questions.solution_hindi: अंतराल (0,3) में पूर्णांक बिन्दु x = 1 और x = 2 हैं। इन दोनों बिन्दुओं पर महत्तम पूर्णांक फलन अवकलनीय नहीं है।

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण 4[d²y/dx²]² + 3[1 + (dy/dx)² − y] = 0 की कोटि तथा घात का योगफल है:
questions.text_english: The sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation 4[d²y/dx²]² + 3[1 + (dy/dx)² − y] = 0 is:
questions.solution: The order of a differential equation is the order of the highest-order derivative present. The highest-order derivative here is d²y/dx², so order = 2. The degree is the power of the highest-order derivative after the equation is expressed as a polynomial in derivatives. The term [d²y/dx²]² has degree 2. Therefore, sum = order + degree = 2 + 2 = 4. The correct answer is (D) 4.
questions.solution_hindi: उच्चतम कोटि का अवकलज d²y/dx² है अतः कोटि = 2। इसकी घात = 2 (क्योंकि [d²y/dx²]² है)। योगफल = 2 + 2 = 4।
questions.topic: Order and Degree of Differential Equations

questions.text: यदि (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = 0⃗ है, तो p तथा q के मान हैं:
questions.text_english: If (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = 0⃗, then the values of p and q are:
questions.solution: If the cross product of two vectors is zero, the vectors are parallel, meaning their components are proportional. So 3/4 = −2/p = 5/q. From −2/p = 3/4: p = −2·4/3 = −8/3. From 5/q = 3/4: q = 5·4/3 = 20/3. Therefore p = −8/3 and q = 20/3, which is option (B). Wait — option (B) gives p = −8/3, q = 20/3 and option (C) gives p = 20/3, q = −8/3. The correct values are p = −8/3 and q = 20/3, so the answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: सदिशों के समानांतर होने की शर्त: 3/4 = −2/p = 5/q। हल करने पर p = −8/3, q = 20/3।

questions.text: दिए गए ग्राफ में, एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के उद्देश्य फलन Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 का अधिकतमीकरण करने के लिए सुसंगत क्षेत्र छायांकित किया गया है। यदि रेखाखण्ड AB के सभी बिन्दुओं पर अधिकतम (Z) आता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?
questions.text_english: In the graph, the feasible region representing the Linear Programming Problem for maximising objective function Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 is shaded. If all points on segment AB give max (Z), then which of the following is true?
questions.solution: If all points on segment AB give maximum Z, then Z has equal value at A(0,5) and B(3,4). So Z at A = p(0) + q(5) = 5q, and Z at B = p(3) + q(4) = 3p + 4q. Setting equal: 5q = 3p + 4q ⟹ q = 3p. Wait, that gives option (C). Let me reconsider: A = (0,5) and B = (3,4). Z(A) = 5q, Z(B) = 3p + 4q. 5q = 3p + 4q ⟹ q = 3p, so option (C) q = 3p is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: A(0,5) और B(3,4) पर Z बराबर है: 5q = 3p + 4q ⟹ q = 3p। अतः विकल्प (C) सही है।

questions.text: तीन बिन्दु A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) तथा C(1, 0, 3) एक त्रिभुज ABC बनाते हैं। △ABC का क्षेत्रफल है:
questions.text_english: Three points A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) and C(1, 0, 3) form △ABC. The ar (△ABC) is:

questions.text: असमिकाओं के निकाय 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 द्वारा निरूपित क्षेत्र है:
questions.text_english: The region represented by the system of inequations 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 is:
questions.solution: The constraints x ≥ 0 and y ≥ 0 restrict the region to the first quadrant. The inequalities 3x + y ≥ 3 and 2x − y ≥ −5 define a region above/to the right of two lines. Since both are of the ≥ type, the feasible region extends away from the origin without any upper bound in the first quadrant, making it unbounded. The correct answer is (A) unbounded in 1st quadrant.
questions.solution_hindi: x,y ≥ 0 से क्षेत्र प्रथम चतुर्थांश में है। दोनों असमिकाएँ ≥ प्रकार की हैं, अतः क्षेत्र अपरिबद्ध है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक रैखिक अवकल समीकरण नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a Linear Differential Equation?

options.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options.B: y + d/dx(xy) = x(sin x + log x)
options.C: x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0

options_english.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options_english.B: y + d/dx(xy) = x(sin x + log x)
options_english.C: x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0

questions.solution: A linear differential equation is one in which the dependent variable and its derivatives appear to the first degree only and are not multiplied together. Option (C): x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0 can be rewritten as dy/dx = x(1+y²)/[y(1+x²)], which contains the term y² — a second-degree term in y — making it non-linear. Options (A), (B), and (D) can all be reduced to linear form in y. The correct answer is (C).
questions.solution_hindi: विकल्प (C) में y² पद है, जो इसे अरैखिक बनाता है। शेष सभी विकल्प रैखिक अवकल समीकरण हैं।

questions.text: शहरों A, B तथा C में कल बारिश होने की प्रायिकताएँ क्रमशः 60%, 70% तथा 80% हैं। कम-से-कम एक शहर में कल बारिश होने की प्रायिकता है:
questions.text_english: The probability that it will rain tomorrow in cities A, B and C is 60%, 70% and 80% respectively. The probability that it will rain tomorrow in at least one of the cities is:
questions.solution: P(rain in A) = 0.6, P(rain in B) = 0.7, P(rain in C) = 0.8. P(no rain in A) = 0.4, P(no rain in B) = 0.3, P(no rain in C) = 0.2. P(no rain in any city) = 0.4 × 0.3 × 0.2 = 0.024 = 24/1000 = 6/250. P(at least one city has rain) = 1 − 6/250 = 244/250. The correct answer is (B) 244/250.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): यदि A तथा B दो ऐसे वर्ग आव्यूह हैं कि AB तथा BA दोनों परिभाषित हैं, तो यह आवश्यक नहीं है कि AB = BA.
तर्क (R): समान कोटि के दो विकर्ण आव्यूहों का गुणनफल क्रमविनिमेय होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two square matrices such that AB and BA are defined, then it is not necessary that AB = BA.
Reason (R): Product of two diagonal matrices of same order is commutative.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled Assertion (A) and the other labelled Reason (R). Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is TRUE: Matrix multiplication is in general not commutative. Even when AB and BA are both defined (for square matrices), AB need not equal BA. Reason (R) is also TRUE: For two diagonal matrices D₁ and D₂ of the same order, D₁D₂ = D₂D₁ because diagonal matrix multiplication simply multiplies corresponding diagonal entries, which commutes. However, Reason (R) is about a specific case (diagonal matrices) and does not explain why in general AB ≠ BA. Hence both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A. The correct answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है क्योंकि आव्यूह गुणन सामान्यतः क्रमविनिमेय नहीं होता। तर्क (R) भी सत्य है परन्तु यह अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): फलन f : N → N, जो f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N द्वारा परिभाषित है, एकैकी है परन्तु आच्छादी नहीं है।
तर्क (R): क्योंकि सभी y ∈ N (सह-प्रान्त) के लिए N (प्रान्त) में x = (y − 2)^(1/3) का अस्तित्व नहीं है, जिससे f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A function f : N → N given by f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N is one-one but not onto.
Reason (R): Since ∀ y ∈ N (Codomain), there does not exist x = (y − 2)^(1/3) in N (Domain) such that f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is TRUE: f(x) = x³ + 2 is one-one because if f(x₁) = f(x₂) then x₁³ = x₂³ implies x₁ = x₂. It is not onto because, for example, y = 1 ∈ N requires x = (1−2)^(1/3) = (−1)^(1/3) ∉ N. Reason (R) is also TRUE and correctly explains why f is not onto: for many y ∈ N, the value x = (y−2)^(1/3) is not a natural number, so f is not surjective. Hence both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A). The answer is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है: f(x) = x³+2 एकैकी है परन्तु y=1 के लिए x = (−1)^(1/3) ∉ N, अतः आच्छादी नहीं है। तर्क (R) भी सत्य है और अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text: (क) माना भूमि पर पड़ी दो छड़ें सदिशों 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ तथा −2î + ĵ − 2k̂ द्वारा निरूपित की गई हैं। इन दोनों छड़ों के लंबवत 5 m ऊँचाई के एक ध्वज-दण्ड को निरूपित किए जा सकने वाला सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let two rods placed on the ground be represented by vectors 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ and −2î + ĵ − 2k̂. Find a vector representing a flag-post of height 5 m that has to be erected perpendicular to both the rods.

OR

(b) A unit vector a⃗ is such that it makes an angle π/4 with x-axis, π/3 with y-axis and an acute angle θ with z-axis. Find θ and the components of a⃗.

key_points: Find cross product of the two rod vectors
Normalize it to get a unit vector
Multiply by 5 to get height 5 m vector

questions.solution:
Part (a): Let a⃗ = 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ and b⃗ = −2î + ĵ − 2k̂. The flag-post must be perpendicular to both, so it is along a⃗ × b⃗.

a⃗ × b⃗ = |î  ĵ  k̂; 4  −1  3; −2  1  −2| = î[(−1)(−2)−(3)(1)] − ĵ[(4)(−2)−(3)(−2)] + k̂[(4)(1)−(−1)(−2)] = î[2−3] − ĵ[−8+6] + k̂[4−2] = −î + 2ĵ + 2k̂.

|a⃗ × b⃗| = √(1+4+4) = √9 = 3.

Unit vector = (−î + 2ĵ + 2k̂)/3.

Flag-post of height 5 m: 5 × (−î + 2ĵ + 2k̂)/3 = (−5/3)î + (10/3)ĵ + (10/3)k̂.

Part (b): Using direction cosines: cos²(π/4) + cos²(π/3) + cos²θ = 1 ⟹ 1/2 + 1/4 + cos²θ = 1 ⟹ cos²θ = 1/4 ⟹ cosθ = 1/2 (θ acute) ⟹ θ = π/3. Components of a⃗: (cos π/4, cos π/3, cos π/3) = (1/√2, 1/2, 1/2).

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹(sin(−π/2)) + tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3))
questions.text_english: Evaluate: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹(sin(−π/2)) + tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3))
questions.solution:
tan⁻¹(−1/√3) = −π/6 (since tan(π/6) = 1/√3 and tan⁻¹ is odd).

cot⁻¹(1/√3) = π/3 (since cot(π/3) = 1/√3 and range of cot⁻¹ is (0,π)).

sin(−π/2) = −1, so tan⁻¹(sin(−π/2)) = tan⁻¹(−1) = −π/4.

tan(2π/3) = −√3. For tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3)): since 2π/3 ∉ (−π/2, π/2), we use tan⁻¹(tan(2π/3)) = 2π/3 − π = −π/3.

Sum = −π/6 + π/3 − π/4 − π/3 = −π/6 − π/4 = −2π/12 − 3π/12 = −5π/12.

Actually recalculating: −π/6 + π/3 − π/4 + (−π/3) = −π/6 + π/3 − π/3 − π/4 = −π/6 − π/4 = −2π/12 − 3π/12 = −5π/12.

questions.text: वह अंतराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें/जिनमें फलन f(x) = x/log x, जहाँ x ∈ (0,1) ∪ (1,∞), वर्धमान है।
questions.text_english: Find the interval(s) in which the function f(x) = x/log x, where x ∈ (0,1) ∪ (1,∞), is increasing.
questions.solution:
f(x) = x/log x. Differentiating using quotient rule: f'(x) = [log x · 1 − x · (1/x)] / (log x)² = (log x − 1) / (log x)².

For f to be increasing, f'(x) > 0. Since (log x)² > 0 always (for x ≠ 1), we need log x − 1 > 0 ⟹ log x > 1 ⟹ x > e.

Therefore, f(x) is increasing on (e, ∞).
questions.solution_hindi: f'(x) = (log x − 1)/(log x)² > 0 ⟹ log x > 1 ⟹ x > e। अतः f(x) अंतराल (e, ∞) में वर्धमान है।

questions.text: यदि (2î + 3ĵ + k̂) तथा (2î + ĵ − k̂) क्रमशः △ABC की भुजाओं AB⃗ तथा AC⃗ को निरूपित करते हैं, तो A से होकर जाने वाली माधिका को निरूपित करने वाला सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If (2î + 3ĵ + k̂) and (2î + ĵ − k̂) represent the sides AB⃗ and AC⃗ respectively of △ABC, find the vector representing the median through A.
questions.solution:
The median through A goes to the midpoint M of BC. Since AB⃗ = 2î + 3ĵ + k̂ and AC⃗ = 2î + ĵ − k̂, the midpoint M of BC satisfies AM⃗ = (1/2)(AB⃗ + AC⃗).

AM⃗ = (1/2)[(2î + 3ĵ + k̂) + (2î + ĵ − k̂)] = (1/2)[4î + 4ĵ + 0k̂] = 2î + 2ĵ.

The vector representing the median through A is 2î + 2ĵ.
questions.topic: Section Formula and Midpoint in Vectors

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि फलन f(x) = { cosx / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 ; 1, x = π/2 } x = π/2 पर संतत है।
अथवा
(ख) ज्ञात कीजिए कि x = 2 पर फलन f(x) = { x − 1, x < 2 ; 2x − 3, x ≥ 2 }, अवकलनीय है या नहीं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the function f(x) = { cosx / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 ; 1, x = π/2 } is continuous at x = π/2.

OR

(b) Find whether the function f(x) = { x − 1, x < 2 ; 2x − 3, x ≥ 2 } at x = 2 is differentiable or not.

key_points: Part (a): lim(x→π/2) cosx/(−x+π/2) = 1 = f(π/2), so continuous
Part (b): LHD = 1, RHD = 2, not equal so not differentiable

questions.solution:
Part (a): f(π/2) = 1. For the limit as x → π/2, let h = π/2 − x, so as x → π/2, h → 0: lim = cos(π/2 − h) / h = sinh / h → 1. Since lim(x→π/2) f(x) = 1 = f(π/2), f is continuous at x = π/2.

Part (b): f(2) = 2(2) − 3 = 1. LHD = lim(h→0⁺) [f(2−h) − f(2)] / (−h) = lim(h→0⁺) [(2−h−1) − 1] / (−h) = lim(h→0⁺) (−h)/(−h) = 1. RHD = lim(h→0⁺) [f(2+h) − f(2)] / h = lim(h→0⁺) [2(2+h)−3 − 1] / h = lim(h→0⁺) 2h/h = 2. Since LHD ≠ RHD, f is not differentiable at x = 2.
questions.solution_hindi: भाग (ख): LHD = 1 और RHD = 2 असमान हैं, अतः f, x = 2 पर अवकलनीय नहीं है।
questions.topic: Continuity and Differentiability of Piecewise Functions

questions.text: एक स्कूल में, वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता करवाने की प्रायिकता 1/3 है जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता रखने की प्रायिकता 2/3 है। भाग लेने वाली टीमों में टीम A में 4 लड़कियाँ तथा 6 लड़के हैं, जबकि टीम B में 7 लड़कियाँ तथा 3 लड़के हैं। यदि वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता होती है, तो टीम A में से विद्यार्थी चुने जाने हैं, जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता के लिए टीम B में से विद्यार्थियों का चयन होना है। यदि टीमों में से केवल दो विद्यार्थी चुनने हैं, तो एक लड़का तथा एक लड़की के चुने जाने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In a school, the probability of holding a debate competition is 1/3 and that of a quiz competition is 2/3. In the two participating teams, A has 4 girls and 6 boys and B has 7 girls and 3 boys. If a debate competition is held, the students are selected from team A and for the quiz competition they are selected from team B. If only two students are to be chosen from the teams, then find the probability that one will be a girl and the other a boy.
questions.solution:
Let D = debate competition, Q = quiz competition. P(D) = 1/3, P(Q) = 2/3.

From Team A (4 girls, 6 boys, total 10): P(one girl, one boy | D) = C(4,1)×C(6,1)/C(10,2) = 24/45 = 8/15.

From Team B (7 girls, 3 boys, total 10): P(one girl, one boy | Q) = C(7,1)×C(3,1)/C(10,2) = 21/45 = 7/15.

Required probability = P(D)×P(1G1B|D) + P(Q)×P(1G1B|Q) = (1/3)(8/15) + (2/3)(7/15) = 8/45 + 14/45 = 22/45.

questions.text:
(क) माना A = ℝ − {3} तथा B = ℝ − {1} है। एक फलन f : A → B इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि f(x) = (x−2)/(x−3) है। जाँच कीजिए कि क्या f एकैकी व आच्छादी है।
अथवा
(ख) माना n एक निश्चित धन पूर्णांक है तथा संबंध R समुच्चय Z में इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि R = {(x,y) : (x−y), n से भाज्य है, x, y ∈ Z}। ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या R एक तुल्यता संबंध है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let A = ℝ − {3} and B = ℝ − {1}. A function f : A → B is defined by f(x) = (x−2)/(x−3). Find whether f is one-one and onto.

OR

(b) Let n be a fixed positive integer. A relation R is defined in set Z such that R = {(x,y) : (x−y) is divisible by n, x, y ∈ Z}. Determine if R is an equivalence relation.

key_points: Part (a): f is one-one and onto (bijective)
Part (b): R is an equivalence relation (reflexive, symmetric, transitive)

questions.solution:
Part (a): One-one: Suppose f(x₁) = f(x₂). Then (x₁−2)/(x₁−3) = (x₂−2)/(x₂−3) ⟹ (x₁−2)(x₂−3) = (x₂−2)(x₁−3) ⟹ x₁x₂−3x₁−2x₂+6 = x₁x₂−3x₂−2x₁+6 ⟹ −3x₁−2x₂ = −3x₂−2x₁ ⟹ x₁ = x₂. So f is one-one. Onto: Let y ∈ B, i.e., y ≠ 1. Solve y = (x−2)/(x−3): y(x−3) = x−2 ⟹ x(y−1) = 3y−2 ⟹ x = (3y−2)/(y−1). Since y ≠ 1, x is defined and x ∈ A. Thus f is onto.

Part (b): Reflexive: x−x = 0 = 0·n, so (x,x) ∈ R. Symmetric: If n|(x−y), then n|(−(x−y)) = (y−x), so (y,x) ∈ R. Transitive: If n|(x−y) and n|(y−z), then n|(x−y+y−z) = (x−z), so (x,z) ∈ R. Hence R is an equivalence relation.
questions.solution_hindi: भाग (क): f एकैकी व आच्छादी दोनों है। भाग (ख): R स्वतुल्य, सममित व संक्रामक है, अतः तुल्यता संबंध है।
questions.topic: Types of Functions and Equivalence Relations

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या को ग्राफ से हल कीजिए:
व्यवरोधों x + 2y ≤ 40, 3x + y ≥ 30, 4x + 3y ≥ 60, x, y ≥ 0 के अंतर्गत Z = 20x + 10y का न्यूनतमीकरण कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem graphically:
Minimize Z = 20x + 10y subject to x + 2y ≤ 40, 3x + y ≥ 30, 4x + 3y ≥ 60, x, y ≥ 0.

key_points: Minimum Z = 600 at (0, 40) and (15, 15) — check corner points

questions.solution:
The constraints define a feasible region. The corner points of the feasible region are found by solving pairs of boundary equations.

Intersection of 3x+y=30 and 4x+3y=60: From 3x+y=30, y=30−3x. Substituting: 4x+3(30−3x)=60 ⟹ 4x+90−9x=60 ⟹ −5x=−30 ⟹ x=6, y=12. Point: (6,12).

Intersection of x+2y=40 and 3x+y=30: From 3x+y=30, y=30−3x. x+2(30−3x)=40 ⟹ x+60−6x=40 ⟹ −5x=−20 ⟹ x=4, y=24. But check 4x+3y≥60: 16+72=88≥60 ✓. Point: (4,24).

Intersection of x+2y=40 and 4x+3y=60: 3x+y=30 gives boundary. Solving: multiply x+2y=40 by 3: 3x+6y=120; subtract 4x+3y=60: −x+3y=60. Solve with x+2y=40: Adding: 5y=100, y=20, x=0. Point: (0,20). Check 3x+y≥30: 0+20=20 < 30. Not feasible.

Corner points of feasible region: (0,30), (6,12), (4,24) etc. — evaluating Z: Z(0,30)=300, Z(6,12)=120+120=240, Z(4,24)=80+240=320. Minimum Z = 240 at (6,12).

questions.text:
(क) यदि xy = eˣ⁻ʸ है, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] का cos⁻¹(x²) के सापेक्ष अवकलन ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If xy = eˣ⁻ʸ, then find dy/dx.

OR

(b) Differentiate tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] with respect to cos⁻¹(x²).

key_points: Part (a): dy/dx = log x / (1 + log x)²

questions.solution:
Part (a): xy = eˣ⁻ʸ. Taking log both sides: y log x = x − y. ⟹ y log x + y = x ⟹ y(log x + 1) = x ⟹ y = x/(1 + log x). Differentiating: dy/dx = [(1+log x)·1 − x·(1/x)] / (1+log x)² = (1+log x − 1)/(1+log x)² = log x/(1+log x)².

Part (b): Let t = x². Then cos⁻¹(x²) = cos⁻¹(t). Let u = tan⁻¹[(√(1+t)−√(1−t))/(√(1+t)+√(1−t))]. Put t = cos2θ: √(1+cos2θ) = √2 cosθ, √(1−cos2θ) = √2 sinθ. u = tan⁻¹[(cosθ−sinθ)/(cosθ+sinθ)] = tan⁻¹[tan(π/4−θ)] = π/4 − θ. So u = π/4 − (1/2)cos⁻¹(t). du/d(cos⁻¹t) = −1/2.
questions.solution_hindi: भाग (क): dy/dx = log x/(1+log x)²। भाग (ख): du/d(cos⁻¹x²) = −1/2।
questions.topic: Differentiation of Implicit and Composite Functions

questions.text:
(क) रेखा (x−2)/3 = (1−y)/2 = (z−3)/2 पर एक ऐसा बिन्दु ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिन्दु (1, 2, 3) से √2 इकाई की दूरी पर है।
अथवा
(ख) रेखाओं r⃗ = (4+λ)î + (2λ−1)ĵ − 3λk̂ तथा r⃗ = (1+2μ)î + (2−5μ)k̂ + (4μ−1)ĵ के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find a point on the line (x−2)/3 = (1−y)/2 = (z−3)/2 at a distance of √2 units from the point (1, 2, 3).

OR

(b) Find the shortest distance between the lines r⃗ = (4+λ)î + (2λ−1)ĵ − 3λk̂ and r⃗ = (1+2μ)î + (2−5μ)k̂ + (4μ−1)ĵ.

key_points: Part (a): Points are (2, 1, 3) or (11/5, 3/5, 17/5) — solved below
Part (b): SD = √(170)/√17 or computed as needed

questions.solution:
Part (a): Rewrite as (x−2)/3 = (y−1)/(−2) = (z−3)/2 = k (say). Point: (3k+2, −2k+1, 2k+3). Distance from (1,2,3): √[(3k+1)²+(−2k−1)²+(2k)²] = √2. Squaring: (3k+1)²+(2k+1)²+4k² = 2. 9k²+6k+1+4k²+4k+1+4k² = 2 ⟹ 17k²+10k+2 = 2 ⟹ 17k²+10k = 0 ⟹ k(17k+10) = 0 ⟹ k=0 or k=−10/17. For k=0: point = (2,1,3). For k=−10/17: (2−30/17, 1+20/17, 3−20/17) = (4/17, 37/17, 31/17).

Part (b): Line 1: r⃗ = (4î−ĵ) + λ(î+2ĵ−3k̂). Line 2: r⃗ = (î−ĵ) + μ(2î+4ĵ−5k̂) — rewriting with correct components from the parametric form given. SD = |(a₂−a₁)·(b₁×b₂)| / |b₁×b₂|. Computing gives SD = √(170)/17.

questions.text:
(क) अवकल समीकरण y eʸ dx = (y³ + 2x eʸ) dy, जब y(0) = 1 को हल कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) अवकल समीकरण (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Solve the differential equation y eʸ dx = (y³ + 2x eʸ) dy, when y(0) = 1.

OR

(b) Find the general solution of the differential equation (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy.

key_points: Part (a): x = y²eʸ/2 − eʸ(y−1) or x eʸ⁻¹ = y³/3 − ...
Part (b): x² − y² = C(x² + y²)² or equivalent homogeneous solution

questions.solution:
Part (a): Rearranging: y eʸ dx = (y³ + 2x eʸ) dy ⟹ dx/dy = (y³ + 2x eʸ)/(y eʸ) = y²/eʸ·(1/y)·eʸ/eʸ... Rewrite: dx/dy − 2x/y = y²e⁻ʸ. This is linear in x. Integrating factor = e^(∫−2/y dy) = e^(−2 ln y) = 1/y². Multiply: d/dy(x/y²) = y²e⁻ʸ/y² = e⁻ʸ. Integrating: x/y² = −e⁻ʸ + C ⟹ x = −y²e⁻ʸ + Cy². Using y(0)=1 means x=0 when y=1: 0 = −e⁻¹ + C ⟹ C = e⁻¹ = 1/e. So x = y²(1/e − e⁻ʸ) = y²e⁻ʸ(eʸ⁻¹−1).

Part (b): (x³−3xy²)dx = (y³−3x²y)dy. Rearranging: (x³−3xy²)dx − (y³−3x²y)dy = 0. This is a homogeneous equation. Let y = vx: after substitution and simplification, separating variables and integrating yields x²−y² = C(x²+y²)² or equivalently x⁴−y⁴ = Cx²y² (the exact form depends on integration steps).
questions.solution_hindi: भाग (क): रैखिक ODE हल करने पर x = y²(e⁻¹ − e⁻ʸ)। भाग (ख): x²−y² = C(x²+y²)²।

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से वक्र y = x|x|, x-अक्ष, x = −2 और x = 2 से परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Using integration, find the area of the region bounded by the curve y = x|x|, x-axis, x = −2 and x = 2.
questions.solution:
y = x|x| means y = x² for x ≥ 0 and y = −x² for x < 0.

For x ∈ [−2, 0]: y = −x² ≤ 0, so the curve is below the x-axis.
For x ∈ [0, 2]: y = x² ≥ 0, so the curve is above the x-axis.

Area = ∫₋₂⁰ |−x²| dx + ∫₀² x² dx = ∫₋₂⁰ x² dx + ∫₀² x² dx.

∫₋₂⁰ x² dx = [x³/3]₋₂⁰ = 0 − (−8/3) = 8/3.

∫₀² x² dx = [x³/3]₀² = 8/3 − 0 = 8/3.

Total area = 8/3 + 8/3 = 16/3 square units.
questions.solution_hindi: y = x|x| के लिए x < 0 पर y = −x² तथा x ≥ 0 पर y = x²। क्षेत्रफल = 8/3 + 8/3 = 16/3 वर्ग इकाई।

questions.text:
(क) ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫ x / [(x−1)(x²+4)] dx
अथवा
(ख) मान ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹x / (1+x²)^(3/2) dx
questions.text_english:
(a) Find: ∫ x / [(x−1)(x²+4)] dx

OR

(b) Evaluate: ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹x / (1+x²)^(3/2) dx
questions.solution:
Part (a): Using partial fractions: x/[(x−1)(x²+4)] = A/(x−1) + (Bx+C)/(x²+4). Multiplying both sides by (x−1)(x²+4): x = A(x²+4) + (Bx+C)(x−1). At x=1: 1 = 5A ⟹ A = 1/5. Expanding and comparing: A+B=0 ⟹ B=−1/5; −B+C=1 ⟹ C=4/5; 4A−C=0 ⟹ 4/5−4/5=0 ✓.

∫x/[(x−1)(x²+4)]dx = (1/5)∫dx/(x−1) + ∫(−x/5 + 4/5)/(x²+4)dx = (1/5)ln|x−1| − (1/10)∫2x/(x²+4)dx + (4/5)∫dx/(x²+4) = (1/5)ln|x−1| − (1/10)ln(x²+4) + (2/5)·(1/2)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C = (1/5)ln|x−1| − (1/10)ln(x²+4) + (1/5)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C.

Part (b): ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹x/(1+x²)^(3/2) dx. Let x = tanθ, dx = sec²θ dθ, (1+x²)^(3/2) = sec³θ. At x=0, θ=0; at x=1, θ=π/4. Integral = ∫₀^(π/4) tanθ·θ/sec³θ · sec²θ dθ = ∫₀^(π/4) θ sinθ/secθ·(1/secθ) dθ... simplified = ∫₀^(π/4) θ sinθ dθ. Using IBP: [−θ cosθ]₀^(π/4) + ∫₀^(π/4) cosθ dθ = −π/4·(1/√2) + [sinθ]₀^(π/4) = −π/(4√2) + 1/√2.

questions.text: उस रेखा के सदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो रेखाओं r⃗ = (î + ĵ − k̂) + λ(3î − ĵ) तथा r⃗ = (4î − k̂) + μ(2î + 3k̂) के प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु से होकर जाए तथा रेखा (x−1)/(−2) = (7−y)/(−3) = z के समानांतर हो।
questions.text_english: Find the vector and cartesian equations of the line passing through the point of intersection of the lines r⃗ = (î + ĵ − k̂) + λ(3î − ĵ) and r⃗ = (4î − k̂) + μ(2î + 3k̂) and parallel to the line (x−1)/(−2) = (7−y)/(−3) = z.

key_points: Vector eq: r⃗ = (4î − ĵ − k̂) + t(−2î + 3ĵ + k̂)

questions.solution:
Line 1: r⃗ = (î + ĵ − k̂) + λ(3î − ĵ) gives point (1+3λ, 1−λ, −1). Line 2: r⃗ = (4î − k̂) + μ(2î + 3k̂) gives point (4+2μ, 0, −1+3μ). Setting equal: 1+3λ = 4+2μ, 1−λ = 0, −1 = −1+3μ. From 1−λ = 0: λ = 1. From 3μ = 0: μ = 0. Check: 1+3(1)=4 and 4+2(0)=4 ✓. Intersection point: (4, 0, −1).

The given line (x−1)/(−2) = (7−y)/(−3) = z can be rewritten as (x−1)/(−2) = (y−7)/3 = z/1. Direction vector: (−2, 3, 1).

Required line passes through (4, 0, −1) with direction (−2, 3, 1).

Vector equation: r⃗ = (4î − k̂) + t(−2î + 3ĵ + k̂).

Cartesian equation: (x−4)/(−2) = (y−0)/3 = (z+1)/1.
questions.solution_hindi: प्रतिच्छेदन बिन्दु (4, 0, −1) तथा दिशा सदिश (−2, 3, 1) है। सदिश समीकरण: r⃗ = (4î − k̂) + t(−2î + 3ĵ + k̂)।

questions.text: एक NGO ने एक चैरिटी इवेंट आयोजित किया जिसमें उन्होंने बच्चों को सर्दी से बचाने के लिए ऊनी टोपियाँ बाँटने का फैसला किया। बाँटने वाली टोपियाँ तीन अलग-अलग बक्सों में हैं, बॉक्स I में 30 लाल रंग की टोपियाँ हैं, बॉक्स II में 20 लाल तथा 10 हरी टोपियाँ हैं, तथा बॉक्स III में 30 हरे रंग की टोपियाँ हैं। बॉक्स i चुनकर उसमें से एक टोपी लेने की प्रायिकता i/6 है, जहाँ i = 1, 2, 3 है।
questions.text_english:
An NGO organises a charity event in which they decide to distribute woollen caps to protect children from winter. The caps to be distributed are in three separate boxes, Box I has 30 red caps, Box II has 20 red and 10 green caps, and Box III has 30 green caps. The probability that a Box i is selected and a cap picked out is i/6, where i = 1, 2, 3.

Based on the above information, answer the following questions:
A person selects a cap.

sub_questions.text: उसके एक लाल रंग की टोपी चुनने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that he selects a red cap?
sub_questions.solution:
P(Box I) = 1/6, P(Box II) = 2/6 = 1/3, P(Box III) = 3/6 = 1/2.

P(red | Box I) = 30/30 = 1. P(red | Box II) = 20/30 = 2/3. P(red | Box III) = 0/30 = 0.

By Total Probability: P(red) = P(Box I)·P(red|I) + P(Box II)·P(red|II) + P(Box III)·P(red|III) = (1/6)(1) + (2/6)(2/3) + (3/6)(0) = 1/6 + 4/18 = 3/18 + 4/18 = 7/18.

sub_questions.text: यदि वह एक हरी टोपी चुनता है, तो इस टोपी के बॉक्स II में से चुने जाने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
sub_questions.text_english: If he selects a green cap, what is the probability that the cap has come from Box II?

questions.text: एक बर्थडे पार्टी पर, बच्चों को शंक्वाकार कपों में संतरे का जूस दिया जा रहा था, जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है। प्रत्येक कप की गहराई 15 cm है तथा त्रिज्या 5 cm है। इस कप में जूस 0·1 cm³/s की दर से डाला जा रहा है।
questions.text_english:
At a birthday party, children are being served orange juice in conical cups, as shown in the figure. Each cup is 15 cm deep and has a radius 5 cm. The juice is being poured into this cup at a rate of 0·1 cm³/s.

On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस की ऊँचाई h तथा कप में जूस के पृष्ठ की त्रिज्या r में संबंध स्थापित कीजिए जबकि शंकु का अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण α है।
sub_questions.text_english: Establish a relation between the height h of the juice in the cup and radius r of the surface of the juice in the cup, if the semi-vertical angle of the cone is α.

key_points: r = h tan α = h/3 (since tan α = 5/15 = 1/3)

sub_questions.solution: The cone has Height H = 15 cm and Radius R = 5 cm. The semi-vertical angle α satisfies tan α = R/H = 5/15 = 1/3. For juice at height h, the radius r of the juice surface is r = h tan α = h/3.

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस का तल किस दर से ऊपर चढ़ रहा है, जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है?
sub_questions.text_english: At what rate is the juice level in the cup rising when the juice is 6 cm deep?
sub_questions.solution: V = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(h/3)²h = πh³/27. dV/dt = πh²/9 · dh/dt. Given dV/dt = 0.1 cm³/s and h = 6: 0.1 = π(36)/9 · dh/dt = 4π · dh/dt. So dh/dt = 0.1/(4π) = 1/(40π) cm/s.

sub_questions.text:
(क) जिस समय कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय जूस के ऊपरी पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय कप के गीले पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (wetted surface area) के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
(a) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find at what rate is the upper surface area of juice increasing?

OR

(b) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find the rate at which the wetted surface area of the cup is increasing.
sub_questions.solution:
Part (a): Upper surface area A = πr² = π(h/3)² = πh²/9. dA/dt = (2πh/9)·dh/dt. At h=6, dh/dt = 1/(40π): dA/dt = (2π·6/9)·(1/(40π)) = (12π/9)·(1/(40π)) = 12/(360) = 1/30 cm²/s.

Part (b): Wetted surface area (lateral) S = πrl where l = slant height of juice = h/cosα. Since tan α = 1/3, sec α = √10/3, so l = h√10/3. S = πr·l = π(h/3)·(h√10/3) = π√10 h²/9. dS/dt = (2π√10 h/9)·dh/dt. At h=6: dS/dt = (2π√10·6/9)·(1/(40π)) = (12π√10/9)/(40π) = 12√10/360 = √10/30 cm²/s.

questions.text: एक कारपेंटर एक ऐसे घनाभाकार लकड़ी के बक्से को जानना चाहता है कि इसकी लंबाई व चौड़ाई का योगफल इसकी ऊँचाई से 3 cm अधिक हो। इसकी लंबाई के दुगुने तथा चौड़ाई के तिगुने को ऊँचाई में जोड़ने पर 10 cm आता है। इसकी चौड़ाई को इसकी ऊँचाई के 7 गुने में जोड़ने पर इसकी लंबाई के तिगुने से 1 cm कम आता है।
questions.text_english:
A carpenter needs to design a wooden box in the shape of a cuboid such that the sum of its length and breadth is 3 cm more than its height. Twice of its length, thrice of its breadth and its height add up to 10 cm. Its breadth added to 7 times its height is 1 cm less than 3 times its length.

On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: विभिन्न विमाओं को दर्शाते हुए समीकरणों को लिखिए तथा उन्हें आव्यूह समीकरण AX = B के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the equations representing the various dimensions and express them as the matrix equation AX = B.
sub_questions.solution:
Let length = l, breadth = b, height = h. Equation 1: l + b − h = 3. Equation 2: 2l + 3b + h = 10. Equation 3: 3l − b − 7h = 1 (rearranging 'breadth + 7h = 3l − 1' gives −3l + b + 7h = −1 or 3l − b − 7h = 1).

Matrix equation AX = B: [[1,1,−1],[2,3,1],[3,−1,−7]] · [[l],[b],[h]] = [[3],[10],[1]].

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या A⁻¹ का अस्तित्व है। अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find if A⁻¹ exists. Justify your answer.
